def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()

        return
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    if k > n:
        print(0)
        return
    a = n - k
    comb = 1
    res = 0

        sign = 1 if ((a - i) & 1) == 0 else -1
        term = sign * comb * pow(i, n, MOD)
        res = (res + term) % MOD
        comb = (comb * i) % MOD
        comb = (comb * pow(a - i + 1, MOD - 2, MOD)) % MOD
    a = max(a, k)
    for i in range(a + 1, n + 1):
        res = (res * i) % MOD
    for i in range(1, n - a + 1):
        res = (res * pow(i, MOD - 2, MOD)) % MOD
    if k != 0:
        res = (res * 2) % MOD
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
